newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Low demand for Bulgaria lev funds, depo rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Low demand for Bulgaria lev funds, depo rates flat.

text.p: Trade was very thin on Bulgaria's interbank deposit market on Thursday due to low demand for lev funds and depo rates were unchanged from Wednesday, dealers said.
"Demand is virtually nil because market players' liquidity is very high," said a dealer.
Overnight depo rates stood at 1.75-2.0 percent annually, unchanged from Wednesday. Spot week rates were around 3.5-4.0 percent annual, also flat.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 3.21 percent on Wednesday against 2.15 percent on Tuesday, a central bank official said.
The central bank's simple annual main interest rate has been set at 6.12 percent since Monday. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
